diagnosis: Same-game child-to-parent SWITCH_RETAINED fails locally before any Gateway request when the existing observer has no cached provider process identity. The switch has already made the UI opaque and stopped child monitoring, while the actor-handoff path closes the old transition coordinator. The pre-mutation catch only completes the switch marker, so the retained transport, audio and input remain live behind an opaque Ready presentation without a working observer.
required_corrections: Resolve provider identity before child-time release and before closing or detaching the old observer: prefer cached exact identity, otherwise use a fresh authenticated snapshot through the immutable old actor context.
Bind fallback evidence through the existing ConsoleStreamTransitionCoordinator ProviderOwner boundary; do not expose a caller-constructible identity.
Accept only the exact current game with a positive PID and valid process token, and preserve the existing stream, app, transition, owner, connection, generation and actor-epoch fences.
Keep RetainedControlHandoff and commitProviderTransferReauthorization as the atomic one-shot commit; close the old observer only after exact ownership transfer succeeds.

On every pre-mutation rejection, preserve or exactly replace the original observer, clear the switch marker before restarting child monitoring, and recover presentation only through LaunchTransitionController with correlated frame or manual-reveal rules.
After any ambiguous child-time or control mutation, keep the existing compensation or verified whole-session termination path fail-closed.
mandatory_regressions: Cached identity missing plus exact old-actor snapshot succeeds without provider or transport restart.
Fallback snapshot finishes before child/session/end, old observer close/detach, or any generation/actor mutation.

Game mismatch, idle/non-exact state, malformed token, non-positive PID, changed owner, claimed cleanup, cancellation, replaced connection and changed generation never reach child release or target reauthorization.
Target authorization mismatch never transfers provider ownership and remains fail-closed after a possible attachment mutation.
Pre-mutation failure completes FAILED, clears the marker before child monitoring restarts, and cannot strand an opaque Ready overlay over live audio/input.
Valid cached identity keeps the current one-shot transfer path unchanged.
Cumulative S05 child A-to-B, full close, next start, actor handoff, dashboard return and retained resume remain passing.
unsafe_substitutes: PID, game name or process name without the exact process token
Target-parent credentials for the fallback snapshot instead of the captured old actor
Child-time release before exact identity resolution
Direct revealStream or input enablement outside LaunchTransitionController
Restarting the provider game or transport for same-game takeover
Weakening any identity, generation or actor-epoch fence
A parallel child-only lifecycle, journal or durable ownership store
